challenge.better_approach: Two cheaper paths were considered and refused. (a) A mechanical rewrite of each path to the same relative path on main, which writes beside an answer without reading it: the 70/70 charter failure. (b) Deleting the measured field, which destroys the citation instead of resolving it. Reading each answer and its lineage is the smallest honest pass, with 34 records and one reader.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a same-named record on main says what the cited worktree copy said. It may not: a worktree ticket can differ from what landed. So each repoint reads the content, and a mismatch is marked resolving nowhere, never repointed. The failure guarded against: the learning backfill that wrote beside 67 charters without reading them, leaving 70 of 70 disagreeing with themselves.
challenge.prior_art: ticket bec37ac3ae5d (the door, which stops new rot; this backfill is the old rot). In-house: the one-mouth-answers-the-learning-question ticket in CLAUDE.md records why a blind backfill fails. No existing sieve resolves measured, and grep for measured_resolves_nowhere over questions and tickets returned nothing.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive. Law 7 (records of truth keep their errors) and a repoint are a distinction to record: the repoint keeps the original path in the record (measured_was), so the error stays visible while the citation resolves.

answers.falsifier: done when every measured answer either resolves through Dataref inside a durable root or carries a resolves-nowhere mark naming why; wrong intent if a repoint lands whose durable record says something other than the answer
answers.from_idea: none, because ticket bec37ac3ae5d measured the 34; the list stands at /home/akien/.akien/temp/dangling_measured_20261121.json
answers.how: A one-pass reader over CairnCommons/questions/*.json lists each answer whose measured is outside cairn:///, cairncommons:/// and instance:/// (34 on 2026-11-21, 32 not on this box; the list rides the cast). For each, CC reads the answer and the cited record's lineage (the same path on main, its ticket file in the commons, the outline_check of the same name) and records one of: repointed to <dataref address>, the durable record agreeing with the answer as written; or measured_resolves_nowhere: <why>. A proof reds any answer whose measured is outside the durable roots and carries no such mark, and reds a repoint whose record is absent. A repoint keeps the old path as measured_was.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a measurement whose record vanishes becomes an unmeasured claim) and Law 7 (errors are permanent in records of truth: an answer is a record of truth, and its citation must not rot)
answers.what: Every answered question whose measured record sits outside a durable root is read and either repointed, through the artifact door's answer verb, to a durable record that says the same thing, or marked as resolving nowhere; none is rewritten without being read.

bullets.text: 34 measured answers cite non-durable records (32 gone here); each is read, then repointed or marked, never backfilled blind
